question: Who among the following is the author of the book ‘On Writing: A Memoir of the Craft’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Stephen King**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Stephen King** is the author of the book ‘**On Writing: A Memoir of the Craft’.**
 
• "On Writing: A Memoir of the Craft" is a memoir penned by acclaimed American author Stephen King.
 
• In this book, King shares his personal journey as a writer and imparts valuable advice for aspiring writers.
 
• Originally released in 2000 by** Charles Scribner's Sons,** this memoir marked King's return to writing after a car accident the previous year.
 
• Scribner has subsequently published two expanded editions of the book: The **10th Anniversary Edition in 2010**, featuring an updated reading list curated by King, and the** 20th Anniversary Edition in 2020**, which includes contributions from King's sons, Joe Hill and Owen.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Stephen Edwin King**, often hailed as the **"King of Horror,"** is a prolific author known for his works spanning horror, supernatural fiction, suspense, crime, science-fiction, and fantasy genres.
 
• With over 350 million copies of his books sold worldwide as of 2006, King's literary legacy includes numerous adaptations into films, television series, miniseries, and comic books.
 
• He has authored around 200 short stories, many of which have been compiled into collections. King's notable novels include "Carrie" (1974), " 'Salem's Lot," "The Shining," "The Stand," and "The Dead Zone."
 
• His contributions to literature have garnered prestigious awards such as the **Bram Stoker and August Derleth Awards,** along with honors recognizing his significant impact on the literary landscape, including the 2003 Medal for Distinguished Contribution to American Letters, the 2007 Grand Master Award from the Mystery Writers of America, and the 2014 National Medal of Arts.
